Messages.Author: Cartman
Messages.Body:
I'm sorry if it has already been answered, but I didn't find anything
relating.
When I put the younger vampire(s) in play, can I act with other ready
minions before having the chained vampires bleed?
Thanx in advance.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Not in general. You cannot take non-mandatory actions when you have any
mandatory actions to perform.
